pages.title: Neurobiology
pages.text: $(thing)Neurobiology$()$(br2)Grow a brain in a dish and ask it what it thinks. Unlocks neural organoids.

$(thing)Insight$(): 110$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Synthetic Biology, Artificial General Intelligence.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Stem Cell Culture.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Ions of valence z and concentration C(x) cross a cell membrane. They drift down their concentration gradient with diffusion constant D, and are also pushed by the electric field from the membrane potential V(x). Write the ion flux j as the sum of both effects, using the thermal energy per mole RT and the charge per mole zF.
